Hi /v/news! I'm relatively new to voat, but I figured I'd share my two-cents on what I've been seeing happen in this subverse. Many articles have been getting linked from dubious websites in the past few days with dubious sources or have been taking facts out of context to twist them into something inflammatory. Many of these posts have made their way to the front page.

Although some people have been questioning the content of the articles, it's clear that many others are simply opvoating them based on the title or a cursory read.

Since voat is currently at a stage where it can be easily influenced by bogus material, I ask that you join me in trying to be extra critical of anything you see posted here. Question it! Don't blindly agree with the nonsense and propaganda that both extreme "Right Wing" and "Left Wing" sources are spouting. In the past few days, I've seen many voaters jump to conclusions about things and begin making accusatory statements about ethnic groups, religious groups, races, genders, organizations, etc. While this is entirely your right to do, do it responsibly! At least make sure that your rage is well-founded.

I've tried to find sources for peoples' questions in the particularly controversial posts, and other voaters have been doing the same, but that doesn't mean that you shouldn't also question those sources! We're here to discuss, to try to find the truth in all the fog created by the larger media. That isn't to say that smaller media outlets don't have their own agendas and aren't similarly biased.

Anyways, that's my two-cents! I hope that we can build a community here that can share facts objectively. I assume it's the reason you're here and not watching Fox news.
